title: Pan-Seared Portobello Mushrooms with Roman Pasta
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring pan-seared portobello mushrooms served with a side of roman pasta. This recipe combines the earthy flavor of mushrooms with the rich taste of pasta.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: For seasoning the mushrooms and pasta

instructions: Cook the roman pasta according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the portobello mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until tender.
Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the cooked pasta and mushrooms in a large serving dish.
Top the pasta with shredded parmesan cheese and serve immediately.
